$comment: Gridline design tokens. Source of truth for values: src/css/tokens.css (screen) and src/css/print.css (print); keep this file in step. Names map to CSS custom properties (--canvas, --accent, ...).

derived.$comment: Light values above are fallbacks; inside @supports (color: color-mix(...)) these follow --accent, so one accent change recolours the family. Dark values stay explicit hex.

status.$comment: Only for state labels (.state, callout-warning, callout-caution). Never a second accent.

type.body: "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
type.mono: Lilex, "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace
type.codeFont: Lilex, "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace

depth.$comment: Hard offsets only, never blurred shadows.
